risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (321.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational consumer discretionary, NFP event in 1 day adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 34 days present binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term technical momentum (RSI extreme overbought, three white soldiers, hull flip, DC20 new high) combined with extreme fear sentiment (18/100) creates a classic contrarian buy setup near support at 67.681.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 321.4, strong dollar), weak trend strength (ADX 13.74), below-average volume, zero fundamental catalysts, earnings binary risk in 34 days, and price below VWAP undermine conviction despite technical overbought conditions.
